Cohorts: Lexicon of Paradox, Nahyndrian Chisel

Display the troop Champions of Mendev

After you put the cohort The Suture in your hand, draw the villain Khorramzadeh from the box and put him on top of your location deck, then explore your location. You win the scenario only when you defeat and corner Khorramzadeh.

When you would summon the servitor demon, summon and encounter the henchman Ravener Terendelev instead.
